verdict.rationale: Replit documents a first-party Replit MCP Server that lets a compatible client create, find, inspect, or update Replit Apps. That is a real programmatic surface, but it covers only a narrow slice of what the UI does. The probe also found no public OpenAPI or REST spec at any candidate path, so UI parity is unevidenced. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose API, programmatic control of publishing/deployments, database, auth, domains, design, Agent chat, and team management, and any evidence of UI parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Connect a compatible client to the Replit MCP Server to create, find, inspect, or update Replit Apps from that client.
